**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Real Estate leads: CCI (1W: +8.73% | 1M: -5.83%) RECOVERY; PLD (news +85) showing bullish flow. Materials strong: NEM (1W: +14.78% | 1M: -4.46%) RECOVERY, FCX (1W: +9.94% | 1M: -6.90%) RECOVERY. Technology showing selective leadership: INTC (1W: +14.24% | 1M: +10.53%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +6.74% | 1M: +7.64%) ABOVE TREND.

Energy under pressure on the week: XOM (1W: -2.87% | 1M: +7.26%) CORRECTION, CVX (1W: -4.24% | 1M: +6.96%) CORRECTION. Communication showing mixed internals: TMUS (1W: -4.82% | 1M: -8.33%) BELOW TREND, NFLX (1W: +5.72% | 1M: 0.00%) RECOVERY.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Big 1W momentum: NEM (1W: +14.78% | 1M: -4.46%) RECOVERY, INTC (1W: +14.24% | 1M: +10.53%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +9.94% | 1M: -6.90%) RECOVERY, CCI (1W: +8.73% | 1M: -5.83%) RECOVERY. Major divergence present — multiple megacaps (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, GOOGL, META, JPM) show 1W vs 1M mismatch, implying a MAJOR DIVERGENCE; treat strength as tactical until follow-through.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Selective Tech rebound: INTC (1W: +14.24% | 1M: +10.53%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +6.74% | 1M: +7.64%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +3.59% | 1M: -3.08%) RECOVERY, GOOGL (1W: +5.29% | 1M: -2.36%) RECOVERY, AAPL (1W: +1.20% | 1M: -2.51%) RECOVERY. Sector breadth: Tech positive (24 stocks; 1W +2.18%); style: Growth/Momentum tilted while confirmation is still mixed.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Financials mixed-to-constructive: JPM (1W: +1.01% | 1M: -1.60%) RECOVERY, V (1W: -1.55% | 1M: -6.14%) BELOW TREND, MA (1W: -1.46% | 1M: -5.64%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: Financials positive (20 stocks; 1W +1.65%) — selective exposure to names that confirm breakouts favored.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Healthcare steady with idiosyncratic winners: LLY (1W: +4.30% | 1M: -6.77%) RECOVERY, JNJ (1W: +1.59% | 1M: -0.92%) RECOVERY, UNH (1W: +3.44% | 1M: -4.30%) RECOVERY, PFE (1W: +2.72% | 1M: +6.39%) ABOVE TREND. Sector breadth: Healthcare positive (17 stocks; 1W +1.03%); watch headline-driven moves for follow-through.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor cyclicals and select techs that are ABOVE TREND or showing confirmed follow-through (INTC, AMD, selected Materials/Real Estate names) and reduce exposure to prolonged underperformers (NKE, UL, CSCO) until they show stabilization. Style: Value/Cyclical tilt within a Rotation regime, but monitor the megacap RECOVERY cluster for confirmation before reallocating core weight.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +14.24% | 1M: +10.53%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +6.74% | 1M: +7.64%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +4.30% | 1M: -6.77%) RECOVERY — watch follow-through on earnings/news. BEARISH: NKE (1W: -15.13% | 1M: -24.64%) BELOW TREND, CSCO (1W: -3.30% | 1M: -1.76%) BELOW TREND — monitor for continuing distribution.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Materials (1W +3.07%; leaders NEM, FCX) and Real Estate (1W +3.94%; CCI). BEARISH: Energy (1W -3.14% | 1M +8.03%) remains vulnerable to a CORRECTION pattern, and Consumer Discretionary (1W -1.47%) because of outsized NKE weakness.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
Watch INTC to hold this week’s breakout (sustain ABOVE TREND for expansion); NVDA to hold recent 1W gains and clear the 1M pivot to confirm Growth momentum (RECOVERY → ABOVE TREND only on a sustained 1M lift); NKE must stabilize above short-term support to reverse BELOW TREND risk. Monitor LLY and BA for news-driven follow-through after bullish headlines.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
LLY (+80): Eli Lilly obesity pill approval / sleep deal; price action RECOVERY (1W: +4.30% | 1M: -6.77%) — sentiment confirming short-term accumulation. BA (+60): Pentagon orders boost; price RECOVERY (1W: +7.13% | 1M: -8.40%) — news aligns with strong 1W momentum. KHC (+55): Kraft Heinz turnaround narrative; price RECOVERY (1W: +5.71% | 1M: -3.61%) — sentiment and price showing alignment.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
CSCO (-50): negative headlines on resilience/growth; price BELOW TREND (1W: -3.30% | 1M: -1.76%) — sentiment confirming weakness. Monitor ASML and PYPL (news -55) for spillover into chip and payments supply-chain risk, respectively, as potential next-stage downside triggers.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION with a Value/Cyclical tilt. INTC (1W: +14.24% | 1M: +10.53%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +14.78% | 1M: -4.46%) RECOVERY and FCX (1W: +9.94% | 1M: -6.90%) RECOVERY are showing relative strength. Key risk: MAJOR DIVERGENCE among megacaps in RECOVERY — watch news-confirmed follow-through (LLY, BA) before shifting core exposures.
